title: Technology Sector Update for 09/27/2018: MFGP, CYBR, ACN
text:

GOOG +1.67%
Technology stocks were continuing to advance in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding almost 0.8% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising about 0.6%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Micro Focus International plc ( MFGP ) was 3% higher Thursday, within close range of its session high. The infrastructure software firm disclosed in a regulatory filing that it repurchased 126,500 shares of its ordinary stock Wednesday.
In other sector news:
(+) CyberArk Software ( CYBR ) climbed almost 8% Thursday and hit a new 52-week high after Morgan Stanley raised its investment rating on the company's shares to overweight from equal weight and also increased its price target by $21 to $92 a share.
(-) Accenture ( ACN ) was down almost 2% Thursday afternoon after the technology consulting company said its fiscal Q4 earnings and revenue beat Wall Street expectations but offered downbeat FY19 earnings guidance. Earnings per share rose to $1.58 from $1.48 a year ago following an 11% year-over-year increase in revenue to $10.1 billion, topping the Capital IQ consensus by $0.02 per share and $100 million, respectively. For FY19, the company is projecting earnings in the range of $6.98 a share to $7.25 a share, lagging the Street view of $7.27 a share.
